page.overview:
Who is Cheese?

Cheese was a Sullustan female who led a group of Tunnel Rats in Tolea Biqua. In 19 BBY, she oversaw their interrogation of the captured Believer, Rydna. She was taller than most members of her species. She also wore a necklace that constantly emitted perfume, making her smell of wildflowers.
